title: Scorpid
wikitext:
[[image:scorpion.png|thumb|]]

The Scorpid are gigantic versions of the scorpion.  They tend to be lone hunters, attacking anything they perceive as a threat with their claws and venomous sting.  Hunting and killing scorpid is considered a rite of passage by the Orcs.  Scorpids are found in [[Durotar]], [[The Barrens]], the [[Burning Steppes]], [[Thousand Needles]], [[Uldaman]], the [[Blasted Lands]], [[Blackrock Depths]], [[Silithus]], and [[Tanaris]].

== As A [[Hunter]] Pet ==
* Have high armor, medium HP, and low damage.
* Eats only Meat.
* Can learn [[Cower]], [[Growl]], [[Claw]], and their special skill, [[Scorpid Poison]].
* Occasionally used as a pet.  The rare spawn Death Flayer is popular, with a stunning black-and-red coloration and an 1.6 attack speed.
